charts.title: Lead-lag test: does Intents volume (or price) lead usage?
charts.sentence: Mean correlation 1-4 weeks ahead: Intents 0.015, price 0.020; noise band ±0.201 (n=95 weeks). Positive k = predictor moves first.
charts.query: weekly sums/means -> log-differences -> Pearson corr(predictor_t, target_t+k)
